snippet.title: Candy Land: Sugary Sprint Available on Nex Playground
snippet.description:
Candy Land Sugary Sprint is here! 🍭
Get ready to jump, dodge and race your way through Candy Land! Be the first amongst friends and family to reach to the castle 🏰🍬🏃 
In collaboration with @hasbroOfficial, we've transformed the classic board game into an active adventure. Now available on Play Pass!
More details: https://shop.nexplayground.com/pages/games-candy-land
